meta.name: automate-this
meta.description: Analyze a screen recording of a manual process and produce targeted, working automation scripts. Extracts frames and audio narration from video files, reconstructs the step-by-step workflow, and proposes automation at multiple complexity levels using tools already installed on the user machine.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将屏幕录制转化为自动化脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常做重复性手动操作想用脚本替代
copy.tagline_en: Turn screen recordings into automation scripts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often perform repetitive manual tasks and want to automate them

howto.what: 当你提供一段屏幕录像时，Claude 会提取每一帧画面和音频，还原你的操作步骤，然后为你的电脑生成能自动执行这些步骤的脚本。
howto.when: 当你录制了重复性手动操作的屏幕录像，并提供视频文件要求分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这个录屏，我手动导出报表的过程能自动化吗？
say.note: Claude 会分析视频并给出脚本。

say.text: 分析这段操作，写个 Python 脚本来替代。
say.note: Claude 会重建流程并产出代码。

say.text: 这个录屏里有好多重复点击，帮我自动化它。
say.note: Claude 会识别重复模式并提议自动化方案。

howto.what_en: When you provide a screen recording, Claude extracts frames and audio, reconstructs your workflow, and generates automation scripts using tools already on your machine.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you record a manual repetitive process and hand the video file to Claude for analysis.

say_en.text: Analyze this screen recording and see if I can automate the report export.
say_en.note: Claude will extract steps and produce a script.

say_en.text: Write a Python script to replace these manual steps from the video.
say_en.note: It reconstructs the workflow and outputs code.

say_en.text: I do these repetitive clicks every day – automate them.
say_en.note: Claude identifies patterns and proposes a solution.
